finding.summary: `Sheet.buildGlobalDependantsMap` extracts references straight from raw `cell.f` with no `expandUnboundedRanges` call, so a purely LOCAL `=SUM(A:A)` throws there and breaks cross-sheet recalculation.
finding.evidence: sheet.ts:2711-2712 `const references = extractReferences(cell.f); for (const ref of toSrefs(references))` and again at sheet.ts:2736-2738 for every formula of every remote sheet. Neither was updated to expand, so `A:A` → parseRange → parseRef('A') → throw. Reached from `recalculateCrossSheetFormulas` (sheet.ts:2773-2804) whenever the sheet holds any cross-sheet formula, e.g. a cell `=SUM(A:A)+Sheet2!B1`.
